children: Overview
UK investment trust's half-year NAV total return rose 3.2%, outpacing inflation
Share price total return for the period was 5.3%
Company repurchased 1.7 mln shares to maintain discount control policy
Outlook
Company says it is proceeding with caution amid geopolitical and economic uncertainties
Company highlights risks from ongoing war in Iran, elevated energy prices, and fiscal vulnerabilities
Company sees potential for economic slowdown if AI investment boom falters
Result Drivers
SHORTER DURATION BONDS - Co said shorter-duration exposure in US TIPS, UK index-linked gilts, and corporate credit outperformed benchmarks
EQUITY SPECIAL SITUATIONS - Equity portfolio returned 18%, with strong performance from investment trust special situations and outperformance of MSCI World Index
INFRASTRUCTURE HOLDINGS - Infrastructure contributed positively, with holdings such as HICL, INPP and 3IN posting double-digit share price gains
